title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Joseph Calabrese is a lecturer in the Department of Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology. He received his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree and Certificate of Advanced Graduate Study in General Dentistry from the Boston University Henry M. Goldman School of Dental Medicine (GSDM) in 1991 and 1992, respectively. He then completed a U.S. Department of Health and Human Services/Bureau of Health Professions Faculty Training Fellowship in Geriatric Dentistry at the Boston Medical Center/GSDM in 1994.
